full_prompt_en: The image is a square black-and-white street-style portrait photographed very close to a man's face and shoulders. He looks upward beyond the top of the frame with wide reflective eyes and furrowed brows. Messy curly dark hair sticks out on both sides of his head. A patterned cap or cloth sits over the hair, and large protective goggles rest across its top. Their thick oval frames and pale lenses make a bold horizontal shape above the face. Dark triangular markings appear beneath both eyes, and a small spot marks one cheek. A thin moustache and pointed goatee frame the mouth and chin. He wears a pale crew-neck shirt with dark overall straps over the shoulders. The background is bright and nearly featureless, giving no precise street or building context. It contrasts strongly with the irregular black outlines of hair, goggles, brows, and straps. Lighting is frontal and diffuse; skin stays in a rich range of grays rather than being flattened to white. Fine pores, stubble, hair strands, and photographic grain remain readable. The camera's near distance exaggerates the apparent size of the face and makes the upward gaze urgent. The lower edge cuts off the torso, while the top edge lies close to the goggle frames. Slight asymmetry in the loose hair and facial marks keeps the strong central composition alive. There is no posed scenic backdrop, furniture, or decorative color. The image feels direct and confrontational, with the expression and improvised headgear carrying the narrative. Its style depends on crisp detail at close range, intense eye contact directed away from the viewer, and high-key empty space surrounding textured dark forms.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形黑白街头感近照，镜头非常接近一名男子的脸和肩。他睁大有反光的眼，眉间收紧，向画幅上方望去。凌乱卷曲的深发向头两侧翘出。发上戴一顶带图案的帽或布，大护目镜架在顶部。厚椭圆镜框和浅色镜片在脸上方形成醒目横形。两眼下有深色三角纹，一侧脸颊有小斑点。细胡须和尖山羊胡框住嘴与下巴。他穿浅色圆领衫，深色背带从肩上越过。背景明亮且几乎没有细节，不提供确切街道或建筑语境。它与发、护目镜、眉和背带不规则的黑轮廓形成强烈对照。光从前方弥散而来；皮肤保留丰富灰阶，没有被冲成白面。细毛孔、胡茬、发丝和摄影颗粒仍可辨。镜头很近，放大了脸的表观尺度，使仰望的眼神显得急切。下边切掉躯干，上边也很靠近镜框。散发与面部标记的轻微不对称让强中央构图保持生气。没有布置好的风景背景、家具或装饰颜色。照片直接而带冲撞感，表情和临时拼出的头部装备承载叙事。其风格依靠近距离清晰细节、指向观者之外的强烈眼神，以及围绕带肌理深形的高调空白。
style_prompt_en: Close monochrome street photography places a sharply detailed face or focal form against high-key, almost empty surroundings. Strong black shapes from hair, accessories, clothing, or graphic markings interrupt the pale field. Frontal diffuse light keeps skin in many gray steps and reveals pores, stubble, and fine grain without theatrical shadow. A near camera position makes expression and irregular contour unusually prominent. Cropping presses the upper and lower edges around the subject, while small asymmetries prevent a static result. The visual effect is immediate and unsentimental, relying on raw texture, gaze direction, and strong white-to-black separation.
style_prompt_zh: 近距离单色街头摄影将清晰细致的脸或焦点形体置于高调、近乎空白的周围。发、配件、衣服或图形标记的强黑形打断浅底。正面弥散光让皮肤保有许多灰阶，显露毛孔、胡茬与细颗粒，却没有舞台式阴影。贴近的机位放大表情和不规则轮廓。画幅上、下边都紧靠主体，小小的不对称避免静态僵硬。视觉效果即时而不煽情，依靠生涩肌理、视线方向与强烈黑白分离。
theme_en: An upward-looking man with goggles on his head in a stark black-and-white close-up
theme_zh: 一名护目镜架在头顶、仰头望去的男子的黑白近景
name: Bruce Gilden
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
